About the Role

As a Finance Business Partner for Payment at GoTo Financial, you’ll be the strategic finance partner for our business team.

In this role, you’ll go beyond financial reporting to influence key business decisions. You’ll work closely with Product, Commercial, and Business teams to optimize merchant unit economics, evaluate pricing strategies, and improve product profitability. Your financial insights will help senior leaders make informed decisions that drive sustainable growth across our merchant ecosystem.

If you enjoy solving complex business problems, partnering with cross-functional teams, and turning data into strategic actions, this role is for you.

What You Will Do

• Drive the monthly, quarterly, annual, or multi-year planning process. Support the development of financial forecasts and operational goals, and apply business judgment and financial insights to help with decision making.
• Build and maintain robust models to evaluate operation and financial metrics, including Take Rate (MDR), interchange fees, Unit Economics (UE), and acquisition costs (CAC).
• Responsible for preparation of the Financial Monthly Business Review process with the Senior Management.
• Track business performance and identify areas of risk & opportunities for further improvements from finance perspectives.
• Responsible to highlight key financial issues and deliver the proposed solutions to the stakeholders
• Highlight critical financial issues and independently deliver actionable, data-backed solutions to cross-functional stakeholders.
• Provide insightful financial analysis on a regular and ad-hoc basis as but not limited to operating metrics performance, business unit performance review, and other financial ratios analysis.

What You Will Need

• Strong communication skills to inform financial information effectively
• Strong analytical skill, curious attitude, and striving to learn
• Thorough, fast, and accurate with high attention to detail
• Able to work under pressure in limited time
• At least 2-5 years experience in FP&A / Finance / Strategy-related areas
• Degree level qualification in Finance / Accounting / Business will be preferred

About the Team

You’ll join a collaborative, data-driven finance team that partners closely with business leaders to turn complex financial data into meaningful insights and strategic decisions.

Working across multiple functions, you’ll gain broad exposure to Product, Commercial, and Operations teams while helping shape the future of GoTo Financial’s merchant ecosystem. Beyond the work itself, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who are generous with their knowledge, value collaboration, and are committed to helping one another grow in a fast-paced environment.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.

PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu, Sidoarjo)

Job Responsibilities:**
* Lead, supervise, and train a team of maintenance technicians, fostering a safe and productive work environment.
* Plan, schedule, and execute preventative maintenance programs for all machinery, equipment, and building infrastructure.
* Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns and implement effective repair solutions to minimize downtime.
* Conduct regular inspections of facilities and equipment to identify potential issues and ensure compliance with safety regulations and company standards.
* Manage and maintain inventory of spare parts and tools, ensuring availability for maintenance needs.
* Implement and monitor maintenance budgets, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or safety.
* Prepare and maintain accurate maintenance records, reports, and documentation.
* Collaborate with production, operations, and other departments to optimize equipment performance and support overall business objectives.
* Ensure all maintenance activities adhere to company policies, procedures, and relevant industry regulations.
* Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for maintenance processes and equipment reliability.

Job Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial) or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a maintenance role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership capacity, preferably within a manufacturing or agricultural processing environment.
* Strong knowledge of industrial machinery, electrical systems, hydraulics, pneumatics, and facility maintenance.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and diagnose complex mechanical and electrical issues.
* Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) is highly desirable.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality standards.
* Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
* Willingness to work flexible hours and be on-call as needed.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Job Summary

PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a dynamic and analytical Market Intelligence Executive for our Strategic Business Unit (SBU) Duck & Ulu Chicken. In this role, you will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, and interpreting market data, competitor activities, and consumer trends within the poultry industry. Your insights will directly support strategic decision-making, product development, and sales strategies to drive the growth and competitiveness of our Duck & Ulu Chicken business segment.

Job Responsibilities

* **Market Research & Analysis:** Conduct comprehensive primary and secondary market research to identify market trends, consumer behavior, and emerging opportunities within the duck and specialty chicken sectors.
* **Competitor Intelligence:** Monitor and analyze competitor activities, including pricing strategies, product launches, distribution channels, and marketing campaigns, providing regular benchmarking reports.
* **Data Management & Reporting:** Collect, organize, and maintain robust databases of industry statistics, demographic data, and sales metrics. Translate complex data sets into actionable insights and clear, concise reports for management.
* **Demand Forecasting:** Collaborate with the sales, marketing, and production teams to assist in forecasting market demand and identifying potential supply-chain impacts.
* **Field Surveys:** Conduct regular field visits, market visits, and stakeholder interviews to gather qualitative insights directly from distributors, retailers, and end-consumers.
* **Strategic Support:** Assist the SBU leadership in formulating business plans, marketing strategies, and product positioning based on concrete market intelligence.

Job Qualifications

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Animal Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of experience in market research, business analysis, or market intelligence, preferably within the FMCG, agriculture, or poultry industry.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (such as MS Excel, SPSS, Tableau, or Power BI) and market research methodologies.
* **Soft Skills:** Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to present complex data clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* **Attributes:** Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel frequently for field research and market visits as required.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
